expectation: Membrane ring on plasmacytoid DCs: rare scattered single round cells, often in lymphoid aggregates, T-cell zones or around vessels in the tumour stroma. Most cells, including epithelium and stroma, should be negative.
notes: In several ROIs there are sparse, bright, cell-sized dots that look like pDCs. Over them lies a diffuse haze that follows epithelial and stromal texture in most ROIs. B and C are grainy, and D shows blobs at the image edge rather than clear membrane rings.
observed: A: most tiles carry a diffuse yellow haze tracing epithelium and stroma. A few tiles (row 1 #3, row 2 #3, row 3 #4) show scattered discrete bright cell-sized dots. B and C: grain following cell density. D: irregular blobs at the edge, no clear ring. No row E.
why: Sparse discrete cells consistent with scattered pDCs show in a few ROIs, but a strong texture-following background lowers their contrast, and D does not confirm membrane rings.
